{{Quote|There she is.''"<br />"''Where? Behind the pile of junk?|[[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|audio=PileOfJunk.flac|<ref name="TCW:RH" />}}
The '''''Sleight of Hand''''' was a modified [[Telgorn dropship]] used by [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as a go-to craft for delivering precious cargo, both living and otherwise. The ship has been heavily customized and re-purposed by Bane himself, who installed military-grade armor and weapons and an advanced hyperdrive.

==History==
[[File:RexAndTeska-TCWRH.jpg|left|thumb|250px |The ''Sleight of Hand'' on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].]]
Using this ship, Bane stole a prototype [[Gravitic polarization beam|gravity weapon]] designed by [[Kul Teska]] in orbit over [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]]. To cover his tracks, Bane destroyed the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] that was carrying the weapon, the frigate crashed on the planet and created a gravity anomaly. Bane took the ship and the weapon to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], where he was captured and forced to co-operate by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Bane took the weapon back to the ship. while the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] guarded him. However, at the ship the trio was confronted by Kul Teska, who engaged the Jedi. Teska initially gained the upper hand, but was forced to retreat when [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Boomer (Advanced Recon Force trooper)|Boomer]] "CS-2207" and [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] "CT-7567" arrived. He took the ''Sleight of Hand'', with both Bane himself and the gravity weapon aboard, and left the planet. Teska eventually arrived at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Behpour/Legends|Behpour]] in [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]], which was soon [[Battle of Behpour|attacked]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the battle Bane shot Teska for the humiliation the former inflicted at Bane, and the ship returned to his possession. Bane took the [[Stabilizer/Legends|stabilizer]]s that ended up sabotaged the [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] before leaving the system aboard the ''Sleight of Hand''.
